title: Lead Research Analyst - Biotech & Biopharma
description:
ABOUT QUALITATE

Qualitate is building the AI-native primary intelligence platform for enterprises, investment firms, and asset managers. We automate the entire primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment through AI-moderated interviews and insight synthesis - replacing weeks of manual research with hours of high-signal output.

Expert research is a broken industry dominated by legacy incumbents with expensive, manual, and slow services. Investment and corporate strategy teams spend hundreds of hours coordinating intermediaries, scheduling expert calls, and synthesizing insights across fragmented providers. The process takes weeks to produce short-lived intelligence.

Qualitate transforms this workflow by autonomously conducting expert discussions at scale using AI. Qualitate’s AI Moderator interviews thousands of experts simultaneously each month, capturing forward-looking purchasing plans, competitive displacement, and real-time ROI signals. The platform turns these interviews into quantified, time-series outputs tracking over 10,000 public and private companies, queryable instantly in natural language. Our customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises, hedge funds, PE firms, credit investors, and venture capital firms.




THE ROLE

Primary research is a core workflow in biotech and biopharma. Diligence, forecasting, and product decisions all run through what practitioners, payers, and buyers are seeing - but that process faces a major scalability bottleneck. We've already solved this bottleneck in several other industries, and demand from the biotech and biopharma market has been loud enough that we're now running the same playbook here.

Reporting to the Director of Research, you'll shape the biotech and biopharma research roadmap, decide what we cover and when, determine the most pertinent questions and KPIs, and publish the insights that establish this coverage in the market. You'll be in front of investors and corporate teams, and you'll be accountable for the outcomes: the quality of the research, its predictive accuracy, and the reputation of Qualitate's biotech and biopharma franchise.




WHAT THE DAY-TO-DAY LOOKS LIKE:

• Leverage the company's proprietary datasets to uncover insightful company and market trends across biotech and biopharma services, medtech, and pharma/biotech for investment funds and corporate clients.

• Develop forward-looking analyses and uncover industry dynamics, key growth drivers, and demand shifts across key biotech and biopharma. 

• Contribute thought leadership by creating high-impact content for our newsletter and client communications.

• Clearly and effectively communicate actionable insights to clients and prospects through calls, webinars, and events.

• Contribute domain expertise and research judgement to hone the fidelity of our first-to-market research methodology; partner with product and engineering teams on design to continue the creation of our best-in-class AI-native research platform.

• Stay ahead of emerging trends, technologies, and innovators shaping the future of biotech and biopharma. 




WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

• 3+ years professional experience in data-driven research creation. Equity research, financial analysis, market research, and/or consulting roles.

• You understand the fundamental research workflow. How funds source ideas and build conviction through data and primary research. You can articulate how Qualitate fits into that process in the terms buyers actually care about. You know which metrics matter to biotech and biopharma investment decisions.

• In-depth knowledge of key Healthcare & Life Science sectors including Pharma, Biotech, Medical Devices, Healthcare Services, Managed Care, Life Science Tools, Digital Health, Health Tech, and emerging fields.

• You communicate your ideas clearly. Long-form and short-form writing expertise required - you must be able to synthesize data into digestible, forward-looking insights. You should feel comfortable talking to investors and corporate clients as an authority on biotech and biopharma.

• You experiment heavily with AI. You’re constantly testing and refining AI tools and agents as they ship, and build them into your daily workflows - automating pieces of your own job to drive higher productivity - and sharing learnings with your team.




WHAT SETS YOU APART

• A strong sense of ownership. You’ll be tasked with turning our existing data collection on the biotech and biopharma industry into a market-defining research product, and continuously iterating on coverage to stay ahead of what’s most topical. You’ll have full ownership over our coverage strategy and research direction in the space, with full autonomy to identify emerging areas of focus that define the ever-changing landscape.

• An analytical mind. You get excited about diving into a large semi-structured dataset to understand key inflections and generate new ideas. Proficiency in managing/analyzing large data sets. SQL experience is strongly preferred.

• You use AI for both speed and rigor. You understand that AI can be used to both accelerate your initial learning in a space and help you go deeper than you otherwise could have - pressure-testing ideas, automating the analyses you never had time for, and expanding what one analyst can rigorously cover.

• You learn and iterate quickly. You’ll be working alongside accomplished professionals across research, product, and engineering. Pick up what they know and implement; impart what’s incremental onto them.

• A real map of the value chain. You know where the useful information sits in this industry - provider and IDN procurement, payer and formulary decision-making, specialty pharmacy, clinical operations, and CRO and supplier organizations - and you know that reimbursement often determines the outcome before the technology does.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Customer Experience runs on data — but right now, that data lives in too many places, speaks too many languages, and reaches the wrong people too late. This role exists to fix that.

As Harvey's first Support Operations Data Analyst, you'll own the analytics function for the Customer Experience org. You'll build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and feedback loops that tell us whether we're hitting our north stars — cSAT, TTR, QA scores, escalation rates — and surface the signal underneath the numbers so we can act on it. You'll sit within the Support Operations team, reporting to the Support Operations Manager, and work closely with Customer Experience leadership and Harvey's central data team to ensure the org is equipped with the right instrumentation as we scale.

 - Own recurring reporting for Customer Experience — weekly, monthly, and QBR-ready — tailored to ops, leadership, and cross-functional audiences

 - Build and maintain self-serve dashboards that give the ops team and leadership real-time visibility into support performance

 - Partner with Support Systems to ensure Zendesk is instrumented to capture the data we need

 - Work with Harvey's central data team to connect support data to broader product and customer data sources

 - Identify and close data collection gaps — if we can't measure it, help define how we should

 - Design feedback loops that connect support signals to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success

 - Quantify the operational cost of product bugs, feature gaps, and onboarding failures

 - Contribute to QA analytics as the QA program matures

 - Track ticket deflection, AI/chatbot performance, and self-service effectiveness

 - Measure the impact of AI-driven support — containment rate, escalation rate from AI interactions, resolution quality — and surface findings that drive how we tune and invest in those tools

 - Support ad hoc analytical requests from the Support Operations Manager, Customer Experience leadership, and senior stakeholders

Required

 - 3–5 years of experience in analytics, with at least 2 years directly in support operations, customer success operations, or a closely adjacent function

 - Fluency in support platform data — you know how Zendesk (or equivalent) is structured, what data it produces, and what it doesn't

 - SQL proficiency — you can write complex queries against large datasets without hand-holding (CTEs, window functions, joins across schemas)

 - Dashboard experience — you've built and maintained operational dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Sigma, Omni, or equivalent

 - Reporting for multiple audiences — you know the difference between what a frontline manager needs and what a CFO needs, and you build accordingly

 - Strong data storytelling — you don't just present numbers, you write the narrative

 - Comfort operating solo — you don't need a team around you to deliver, and you don't need a ticket to tell you what to look at

Strong Plus

 - Experience with Python for data manipulation or automation

 - Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tooling

 - Experience building or contributing to QA analytics programs

 - Background supporting enterprise SaaS or AI-native products

 - Experience working with Zendesk APIs or extracting data beyond standard reporting

Key Attributes

 - AI-native: you use AI tooling actively in your analytical workflows — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier

 - Pace: you move in hours and days, not weeks. You surface findings before anyone has to ask

 - Judgment: you know which metrics matter and which are vanity. You push back when framing is wrong

 - Clarity: your outputs are direct, jargon-free, and actionable. You write for the reader, not yourself

 - Ownership: you treat Customer Experience analytics as your problem to solve, not a ticket queue to process

OUR MISSION: ELIMINATING EVERY BARRIER TO MENTAL HEALTH.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

As an Operations Manager on our revenue cycle management team (RCM), you will use data-driven insights to drive strategic change, partnering closely with Operations leadership to eliminate workflow bottlenecks, improve efficiencies, and support our providers with a best-in-class experience. You will interact regularly with cross-functional partners—including Product / Engineering, Business Intelligence, CX Strategy, and Payer Partnerships—to ensure our workflows and technology roadmaps set Alma up for success at scale. The ideal candidate has a strong bias towards action, excels at motivating and coaching large teams, prioritizes a winning team culture, and thrives in ambiguous situations. This is a full time, fully remote position on our team. Occasional travel may be required for company or team events/meetings.

What you’ll do:

 - Process Optimization & Scale: Identify operational bottlenecks and trends. Use data and analytics to prioritize work, design process changes, execute change management, and optimize existing workflows for continued growth and scalability.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Product & Engineering, Business Intelligence, CX Strategy, and other Core Ops teams to analyze and measure the operational impact of tools, processes, and product launches on Core Ops KPIs. Own, execute, and report on identified cross-functional escalation projects.

 - Metrics Ownership, Data Analytics & Reporting: Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly program and metrics data to track operational efficiency, reporting outcomes and key insights regularly to leadership and business stakeholders.

 - Strategic Planning & Roadmap Alignment: Strategize with Operations leadership to marry staffing plans with technology roadmaps to streamline the insurance process, and support forecasting and resource planning to ensure the team is appropriately resourced.

 - Team Leadership & Management: Lead, coach, and manage a core operations team (including 2+ direct reports/Team Leads and a subsequent remote frontline workforce of agents up to 20 employees); unblock the team in day-to-day escalations and foster a winning team culture.

What success looks like in this role:

 - Maintain key service level agreements (SLAs) and support ticket resolution metrics within targeted operational thresholds.

 - Successfully complete core workflow optimization projects within target timeframes and resource constraints.

 - Achieve high internal partner and stakeholder satisfaction scores across cross-functional operations.

 - Optimize operational efficiency metrics by streamlining manual steps across primary workflows.

What you’ll bring:

 - 3-5 years of professional work experience in an Operations role, ideally within a startup environment, healthcare implementation, healthcare consulting, or a revenue cycle management role.

 - 2-4 years of people management experience, managing teams comprised of non-exempt and exempt direct reports. You have experience navigating the full spectrum of performance management — from setting clear expectations and delivering ongoing feedback to supporting employees through formal improvement processes and difficult conversations.

 - Highly resourceful and efficient at data-driven decision-making, operational process design, improvements, and execution.

 - AI-forward: Has experience leveraging AI to drive speed to results. 

 - Relentlessly organized with meticulous attention to detail and exceptional project management skills; ability to balance attention to detail with swift execution.

 - A flexible team player who can roll up their sleeves to support the team creatively and scrappily while managing other projects through ruthless prioritization.

 - Exceptional communication skills and a customer-centric attitude. Able to translate and communicate accurately and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

 - Passionate about mental health, our mission at Alma, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DE&I).

Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com http://paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

You'll be the sole member of our Corporate Development function, working side by side with the executive team on Paxos's fundraising and inorganic growth. You'll partner with executive and product leadership to develop investment theses, and work with teams across the company to make sure deals deliver after they close.

About the role

The Corporate Development Lead serves as the driver of Paxos's inorganic growth strategy, identifying, structuring, and executing acquisitions, and owning process management for our fundraising efforts as we scale. You will own the full M&A lifecycle. You will also support the CEO and CFO on end-to-end fundraise processes, helping tell the Paxos story to the right capital partners at the right time.

What you’ll do

 - Own the M&A process end-to-end:
   
   - Develop Investment and M&A theses by researching and monitoring emerging trends and disruptive companies and deeply understanding Paxos product strategy and overall priorities
   
   - Source, evaluate, and execute acquisitions - lead cross-functional diligence, drive structuring, negotiation, and close
   
   - Build and maintain a live pipeline of targets aligned to Paxos’s strategic priorities across infrastructure, distribution, and regulated capabilities
   
   - Conduct analysis of operating performance, lead market diligence, and prepare investment memos. Develop rigorous financial models and valuation frameworks

 - Own fundraising process & investor relations:
   
   - Lead end-to-end equity fundraise processes - drive workstreams, prepare investor materials, build and manage data rooms, coordinate diligence, and control the process timeline; serve as the day-to-day owner ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and the CFO and CEO are focused where they matter most
   
   - Maintain ongoing relationships with current and prospective investors between raises providing regular investor updates

 - Be a strategic partner to the executive team:
   
   - Bring an informed external view - on competitors, market structure, and emerging opportunities - into our strategic planning process; translate what you’re seeing in the market into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership

 - Continue to scale Paxos Ventures. To date, Paxos has made over 25 venture investments across the digital asset space
   
   - Source, evaluate and recommend early stage venture investments that further Paxos strategic priorities
   
   - Partner cross-functionally across the company to support founders and portfolio companies
   
   - Help build our founder community by planning programs and events that convene portfolio companies, investors, and others in the ecosystem

 - Build the corp dev muscle at Paxos: Establish repeatable processes for deal sourcing, evaluation, and integration planning; develop the templates, frameworks, and institutional knowledge that make us faster and sharper with every transaction

About you

We’re looking for someone who is entrepreneurial, analytical and very comfortable operating in ambiguity. You help bring focus and structure to ambiguous situations to chart a clear path forward. You might come from investing (Banking, PE, VC) or a Corp Dev team at a fast-growing (fin)tech company.

 - Demonstrated track record of executing M&A or investment transactions - you have closed deals, not just supported them

 - Strong financial modeling and valuation skills

 - You enjoy building relationships

 - Proven ability to own a fundraising process end-to-end - managing workstreams, materials, and investor relationships with minimal oversight

 - Familiarity with the blockchain infrastructure, digital asset, or fintech space is a plus

 - Excellent communication skills - you can present a nuanced deal thesis to a CFO and explain a term sheet to an engineer

 - Comfort operating as an IC in a fast-moving environment; you don’t need a team to be effective, and you know how to pull in the right internal stakeholders at the right moment

 - You default to AI and take pride in your work. You are building agents, vibe-coding apps, and more.

 - You likely have 7+ years of work experience

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

 - Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers

 - We only use @paxos.com http://paxos.com email addresses

 - We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

 - For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

title: Senior Data Analyst, Product Analytics
description:
SENIOR DATA ANALYST, PRODUCT ANALYTICS
 Current is a leading consumer fintech platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans with over 6 million members. We provide access to financial solutions that seamlessly work together to solve the needs of our members and enable all Americans to build better financial futures. Based in NYC, our results-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes.
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Product Analytics to play a central role in how our product and business teams make decisions. You will be embedded with teams across areas such as banking, user journey and experience, liquidity, and value-added services, owning the analytics agenda for your area from question to recommendation. This is a high-ownership role: you will lead experimentation, drive deep-dive and root-cause analyses, build business cases, and help your partners set strategic roadmaps. You are equally comfortable writing complex SQL and presenting a clear point of view to leadership, and you raise the analytical bar for the people around you.
 RESPONSIBILITIES
- Own the product analytics agenda for your embedded area, partnering with product, engineering, finance, and business leaders to scope, prioritize, and deliver high-impact analyses.
- Lead the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments, including success metrics, power and sample sizing, statistical inference, and learning briefs.
- Conduct deep-dive and root-cause analyses on trends, funnels, retention, and engagement, turning ambiguous problems into clear business opportunities.
- Build business cases that size opportunities, quantify impact, and inform investment and roadmap decisions.
- Help department leaders define success metrics and strategic roadmaps grounded in data.
- Provide clear, actionable insight to stakeholders on business performance, customer behavior, and metric trends, and present findings and recommendations to leadership.
- Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and Looker explores that track KPIs across product, finance, and operations.
- Partner with analytics engineers and data engineers to improve data models, definitions, and reliability, and to validate outputs before they reach stakeholders.
- Use AI tools to improve efficiency in analysis, insight generation, and reporting, and share best practices with the team.
- Mentor and support other analysts, contributing to team standards for analysis design, experimentation, and storytelling.
 ABOUT YOU
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 5+ years in a data analytics role, with at least 3 years in product analytics, where you owned multiple concurrent workstreams and operated with a high degree of autonomy.
- 2-3 years in a consumer-facing fintech, digital banking, payments, or lending environment (or similar B2C setting), working with transactional data, product metrics, and customer behavior at scale.
- Advanced SQL in a cloud data warehouse environment (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift), including window functions, CTEs, and complex joins.
- Python experience for data analysis, automation, and statistical work.
- Strong expertise in experimentation, including A/B/n testing, significance testing, and statistical inference.
- Proven track record of taking analytical projects from scoping through to delivery, with ownership over outcomes, not just outputs.
- Experience building dashboards and reports in Looker or comparable BI tools.
- Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
- A proven ability to use data to change minds and drive decisions.
 NICE TO HAVE
- Direct experience in D2C or consumer fintech, including banking, liquidity, or value-added services.
- Experience building business cases and contributing to roadmaps or strategic planning.
- Hands-on experience with dbt or comparable transformation tools, and familiarity with dimensional modeling.
- Experience using AI tools to improve analytics efficiency and insight generation.
- Experience mentoring analysts or leading cross-functional workstreams, even informally.
- Familiarity with unit economics concepts such as ARPU, contribution profit, and cohort LTV.
 This role has a base salary range of $150,000 - $200,000. Compensation is determined based on experience, skill level, and qualifications, which are assessed during the interview process. Current offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
 BENEFITS
- Competitive salary
- Meaningful equity in the form of stock options
- 401(k) plan
- Discretionary performance bonus program
- Biannual performance reviews
- Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100% for you and your dependents
- Flexible time off and paid holidays
- Generous parental leave policy
- Commuter benefits
- Fitness benefits
- Healthcare and Dependent care FSA benefit
- Employee Assistance Programs focused on mental health
- Healthcare advocacy program for all employees
- Access to mental health apps
- Team building activities
- Our modern NYC based office with open floor plan, stocked kitchen, and catered lunches

title: People Operations AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from people ops, HR or workforce planning, across headcount, compensation or org design, who build headcount plans, comp models and people analytics in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the work of a People Ops Analyst.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

 - Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

 - Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them
   
   


NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years in people operations, HR analytics, total rewards or workforce planning, covering headcount, compensation, benefits or org design

 - Deep hands-on Excel: headcount and comp models, named ranges, multi-criteria lookups, pivot tables and conditional formatting

 - Strong written English communication skills.

 - Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals
   
   


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 - Start Date : Immediate

 - Duration: Approximately 4–6 weeks

 - Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.
   
   


CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

 - You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

 - This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

 - Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

 - Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

 - Payments will be weekly following task completion.
   
   


GETTING STARTED

 - Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

 - Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

 - Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

 - We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

 - Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.
   
   


ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.
